verdict.rationale: LibreChat documents an Agents framework for building multiple custom assistants on various model providers through a no-code Agent Builder, each with its own tools, files, Skills, and conversation starters. Conversations are routed to a chosen agent via the Side Panel dropdown or an "@" mention in chat, and an Agent Management API supports creating and managing agents programmatically. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of per-agent system prompts/instructions, isolated per-agent workspaces beyond agent files, routing of external channels to agents, and independent hands-on corroboration.
